author: DamiLee
description:
The Colosseum isn't a circle; it's an ellipse. This wasn't an accident.

From the movement of gladiators to the emperor's point of view, every part of its design was engineered to keep your attention locked on the action. While there have been other oval stadiums, the Colosseum was the first arena to enclose the amphitheatre inside a monumental, multi-story architectural shell, creting a controlled environment.
